item.title: fix(skills): preserve local changes during updates (#118190)
item.summary: fix(skills): preserve local changes during updates (#118190) Prevent ClawHub skill updates from silently replacing locally modified files. Verify recorded install digests at the rollback boundary, restore on mismatch, and require explicit --force for unverifiable legacy installs. Co-authored-by: yetval Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
